extDescription.message: Find, change and capture Mycelium tasks and notes from any page.

menuCaptureTask.message: New Mycelium task from this page

omniboxHint.message: Search Mycelium, or paste a task or note code

switchOffBody.message: Nothing is being sent. Your credential and any unsent draft are kept: this is a mute, not a sign-out.

notConnectedBody.message: Connect this browser to Mycelium. It opens the app, where you approve exactly what is being granted.

revokedBody.message: This browser's credential is no longer accepted. It may have been revoked in Mycelium, or it expired.

disconnectNote.message: Forgetting removes the secret from this browser only. Revoking it on the server is done in Mycelium settings.

scopeNotesClientWarning.message: Notes are not narrowed by a client, only by a project.

warmingUp.message: Searching… the index is waking up

emptyNoQuery.message: Type to search, or paste a task or note code.

outcomeUnknown.message: We stopped waiting. The change may or may not have been saved.

conflict.message: This changed while you were looking at it. Reloaded.

captureFileSidePanelOnly.message: Choosing a file closes this popup. Open the side panel to attach one.

captureAttachmentsFailed.message: Created, but these did not attach: $NAMES$

captureSelectionBlocked.message: Chrome does not let extensions read this page, so the selection could not be included.

screenshotWrongTab.message: Chrome only lets the extension photograph the tab you invoked it from.

sinceYouLeftOk.message: While the panel was closed: $N$ saved.

sinceYouLeftFailed.message: While the panel was closed, these did not save: $NAMES$

errDisconnected.message: This browser is not connected to Mycelium.
